editorial.blurb: A charming basement wine bar in Chicago with exceptional cocktails, carefully crafted seafood plates, and service that feels genuinely warm.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive shortly after opening for quick bites at the bar, or ask your server what the special is if you're feeling adventurous—and always save room for dessert, especially the phyllo cake.
signatureDishes: Picanha Steak Plate with Spring Asparagus

topDishes.note: Unique and fantastic with deeply flavored sauce
Standout plate with perfectly paired sauce
